objective: Gate C R3 idempotente posterior a convergencia certificada de runtime: reejecutar el resync historico completo de SoftRestaurant mediante la capability cerrada SOFTRESTAURANT_FULL_HISTORY_RESYNC sobre todas las unidades SoftRestaurant resueltas por configuracion canonica. Usar exclusivamente el --execute fijo de la capability. No aceptar shell, script_path arbitrario ni rutas externas. Publicar operation_summary sanitizado si alguna unidad falla y certificar mediante SQL de solo lectura. No tocar Edarsahub_Produccion.

queries.name: softrestaurant_full_history_target_tables_exist_after_write_r3
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id WHERE s.name = 'dbo' AND t.name IN ('Finanzas_CortesCaja','Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos') ORDER BY t.name;

queries.name: softrestaurant_full_history_cortes_count_after_write_r3
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_rows FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja;

queries.name: softrestaurant_full_history_detalle_pagos_count_after_write_r3
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_rows FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos;
